description: Facts about one composition by its LC code, as its page on vargov.ru shows them: description, where it works, style, elements in stock, the serial certificate (regulations and validity; the document numbers are on the composition page), the free 3D model (max, fbx), videos and awards — plus the element material where the brand has confirmed it. A null field means the brand does not state it, not that the answer is no. No prices: every composition is made to order and the price is calculated for each project.

code.description: LC article code: LC0413, lc 413 or 413.

lang.description: Language of the result: ru, en, de, it, fr, es, vi or ar. Default en.

name: get_composition
title: Composition facts
